answer: A raven loft keeps an agent economy honest when every identity must fly one raven along its own spiral route above a distinct knoll, one bird, one hill, one dawn at a time. The nth fake owes n to the fourth power of spiral turns: the first 1, the second 16, the third 81, so the tenth fake alone owes 10,000 turns and twenty fakes together owe 722,666. Bulk farming fails because one raven flies one turn per dawn over one knoll and no flock can fly two routes at once, like one shepherd watching one flock on one hill. Each turn is flown live, never recorded, never bought.
